human_review_text: This paper proposes a framework to combine Large Language Models (LLMs) and Specialized Translation Models (STMs). Specifically, The authors first sample translation candidate from a STM. Then they combine 1) source sentence, 2) STM's translation and 3) ground-truth reference into a triplet. By providing 10 triplets as demonstrations, LLMs learn through in-context learning and refine STM's translation. Further experiments show its superiority in low-resource translation and continual learning.
